<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
    if not red_nodes:
        return None
    all_rows, all_cols = [], []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])
    return (min(all_rows), max(all_rows), min(all_cols), max(all_cols))

# Current position
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"Current: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Go UP to reach Position J
result = action(['UP'])
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
print(f"UP: cells={cells}, rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
    print("Level completed or game over!")

# Go RIGHT to reach Position K
result = action(['RIGHT'])
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
cells = last_action_result['executed_actions'][0]['animation']['total_cells_changed']
print(f"RIGHT: cells={cells}, rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
    print("Level completed or game over!")

# Check final state
pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"\nFinal: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
print(f"Level: {current_frame.level}")
print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check for orange dots
seg = current_frame.segmentation
orange_dots = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O' and n['pixels'] <= 5]
print(f"Orange dots: {len(orange_dots)}")
for od in orange_dots:
    print(f"  pixels={od['pixels']}, boundary={od['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
